title.en: Praised stylists Jenna, Samantha, and Ziggy

text.en: Regular clients at the Happy Valley Road salon frequently commend groomers Jenna, Samantha, and Ziggy for their friendly service and dedication. While one long-time customer had difficulty explaining styling requests to a groomer and felt rebuked at pick-up, most reviewers express strong appreciation for the salon staff.

title.en: Neat grooms alongside an unfinished session

text.en: Most pet owners are pleased with the grooming results, noting clean coats and tidy nail trims on their dogs. However, one reviewer mentioned that their dog's session was left incomplete because the pet became feisty, leaving the owner needing to arrange a return visit to finish the haircut.

Several owners highlight that their dogs remain comfortable and happy when visiting the Deer Valley grooming salon. Reviewers with Yorkshire terriers and other breeds note that stylist Ziggy is attentive to their pets' comfort, and dogs are often eager to walk in for their appointments.

q.en: Which groomers do clients recommend at the Happy Valley Road salon?

a.en: Reviewers regularly mention Jenna, Samantha, and Ziggy for attentive care and consistent grooming results.

q.en: Can grooming appointments take longer for larger breeds?

a.en: Yes, one husky owner noted that the session took longer than usual, and another client reported waiting at the register during collection.

q.en: Does this Petco location offer walk-in nail trims?

a.en: Yes, the salon provides walk-in nail trimming alongside full-service baths, breed haircuts, and de-shedding treatments.
